command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingWeightedMoment.lean').read_text();s=s.replace('theorem weighted_first_moment','''theorem nat_mul_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) (q : ℕ) :
    q * (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, q*f i := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert j s hj ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj, Nat.mul_add, ih]

theorem nat_sum_mul {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) (q : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * q = ∑ i ∈ s, f i*q := by
  simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using nat_mul_sum s f q

theorem weighted_first_moment''').replace('Finset.sum_mul','nat_sum_mul').replace('Finset.mul_sum','nat_mul_sum').replace('smul_eq_mul, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter','smul_eq_mul, bad, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter').replace('by simp only [Nat.mul_assoc]; rfl','by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc 4 100]; rfl')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingWeightedMoment.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
